progress.title: Control/1 progress
progress.description: Closed progress resource governed by Wsprry-Control/1. Runtime authority and cross-field validation remain mandatory.

sequence.description: Canonical uint64 decimal; semantic validator enforces uint64 maximum.

fields.description: Independent fields except pins and drive: malformed pins/polarity or drive rejects the entire batch atomically.

frequency_hz.description: Whole-Hz WSPR USB dial. Nominal RF center is dial + 1500 Hz; all four RF tones must satisfy the selected engine and frequency permissions. Bounds cover supported 132/138/150 MHz engines; the server applies the selected engine limits.

anyOf.description: Whole-Hz WSPR USB dial. Nominal RF center is dial + 1500 Hz; all four RF tones must satisfy the selected engine and frequency permissions. Bounds cover supported 132/138/150 MHz engines; the server applies the selected engine limits.

application.title: Control/1 application
application.description: Closed application resource governed by Wsprry-Control/1. Runtime authority and cross-field validation remain mandatory.

schedule_dial_frequency_nhz.description: Saved standalone WSPR USB dial in exact integer nHz; string 0 means unset and nontransmitting.
